all_6_complete_types_and_body_hashes_ind.name: sqrt_product_majorant
all_6_complete_types_and_body_hashes_ind.complete_type:
private theorem sqrt_product_majorant {F G C D Y : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hY : 0 ≤ Y) (hG : 0 ≤ G)
    (hFbound : F ≤ C * Y) (hGbound : G ≤ D * Y) :
    Real.sqrt (F * G) ≤ Real.sqrt (C * D) * Y

all_6_complete_types_and_body_hashes_ind.name: log_budget_cancel
all_6_complete_types_and_body_hashes_ind.complete_type:
private theorem log_budget_cancel (C x L : ℝ) (P A : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) :
    C * x ^ 2 * L ^ P / L ^ (P + 2 * A) = C * x ^ 2 / L ^ (2 * A)

all_6_complete_types_and_body_hashes_ind.name: originalVariance_sub_retained_le_capped_log
all_6_complete_types_and_body_hashes_ind.complete_type:
theorem originalVariance_sub_retained_le_capped_log
    {B A : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (hkappa : 0 ≤ kappa) (hcap : kappa ≤ 1 / (2 * (kshift : ℝ))) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
        |originalVariance d - retainedVariance d
          ((1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ cutoffExponent B A)| ≤
      retainedVarianceSavingConstant B * d.scale ^ 2 /
        (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ (2 * A)

all_6_complete_types_and_body_hashes_ind.name: constant_pos_and_uniform
all_6_complete_types_and_body_hashes_ind.complete_type:
theorem constant_pos_and_uniform (B : ℕ) :
    0 < retainedVarianceSavingConstant B ∧
      ∀ (A : ℕ) (sigma kappa c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom),
        MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d → 0 < sigma → 0 ≤ kappa →
          kappa ≤ 1 / (2 * (kshift : ℝ)) →
        CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
            |originalVariance d - retainedVariance d
              ((1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ cutoffExponent B A)| ≤
          retainedVarianceSavingConstant B * d.scale ^ 2 /
            (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ (2 * A)
